t: A small square touchscreen computer with a battery, speaker and sensors in one case.
steps: Buy the Core2 v1.3 from the M5Stack Store for about 39 US dollars, or from RobotShop in the US.
Plug it into your computer with a USB-C cable. Some Windows and macOS computers need the CH9102 USB driver.
Open the UiFlow web editor from M5Stack and connect the Core2.
Drag a block that shows a label on the screen and run it.
Add a touch button block that plays a sound.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the M5Unified library for text-based coding.
Use M5GFX version 0.2.27 or newer. Newer units have a screen chip that older versions cannot drive.
Upload an M5Unified example that reads the motion sensor.
meta: Open Board. From $39.04. A few stores.
